title: I Was a Guest on The Pen Addict
summary: I talked to Brad about St Jude, notebooks, and art
content:
Brad is walking in Memphis this week for the podcastathon so we recorded this episode a couple of weeks ago.

We talked about the incentives we're both offering for St Jude and the work that goes into those as well as my progress as an "artist", and Jimothy. Then we discussed finishing notebooks and inks, and finished off with my analog defaults. There's still a few days to donate to St Jude.

Listen to The Pen Addict 736: I’ll Keep You All Knight
